title: CommonsFeedBlockedItem
description: One pending blocked-decision entry as it appears in 'cmux rpc feed.list' for a spawned worker. This is the boundary contract of the daemon's journey: the surface-worker-decisions feature (producer) guarantees a worker's escalation-worthy decision is published in this shape, and bridge-cmux-feed's CmuxFeedSource (consumer) reads exactly these fields into its frozen FeedItem. Mirrors src/atdd/mediate_worker_decisions/bridge_cmux_feed/src/domain/feed_item.py. Only kinds question | permission | exitPlan are blocked decisions; toolUse/telemetry entries are not.

operations.description: List pending blocked-decision items from the cmux Feed

request_id.description: Stable identifier of the underlying decision request, used for idempotent answering and dedup across ticks/restarts.

kind.description: The blocked decision kind, exactly as cmux emits it.

status.description: Item status. A blocked decision is pending (or unset); resolved/telemetry items are not consumed.

question_prompt.description: For kind=question: the prompt text presented to the user.

tool_name.description: For kind=permission: the tool requesting permission (e.g. Bash).

tool_input.description: For kind=permission: the tool input verbatim (e.g. the bash command), matched by the daemon's danger gate.
